title: epicampes distichophylla
intro: Epicampes distichophylla, commonly known as the "Hawaiian hawthorn", is a plant species belonging to the family Euphorbiaceae. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exerting antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Epicampes distichophylla include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardiovascular protective effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
